ending_v1_first_week_desc: Six days of navigating Dhaka's unpredictable roads, surviving traffic jams, negotiations, and monsoon rain. Your journey as a rider has just begun.
ending_independent_rider_desc: You bought your own motorcycle, paid off all debts, and ride on your own terms.
ending_workshop_owner_desc: You partnered with Kamal bhai and opened a garage workshop, building a lasting business.
ending_trusted_local_desc: Everyone in the neighbourhood knows and trusts you. Direct calls keep your pockets full and your community close.
ending_fast_money_desc: You chased the big cash and walked the razor's edge. The money was fast, but the streets never forget.
ending_fresh_start_desc: Low ratings and unpaid debts caught up with you. Time to regroup, repair, and start fresh.
